messages:
erin_sales: Quick one from Acme POC: they want a single-page ops checklist + exact SOW language for USB delivery. Items they care about: HSM signing vs customer-sign kit, SBOM format, upgrade cadence, billing on delivery vs applied, and a 24h emergency hotfix promise. Can we agree bullets they can sign?
vikram_se: TL;DR: we support HSM-backed detached signatures and a customer-sign kit. SBOM delivered as SPDX or CycloneDX in the bundle root. Recommended cadence: quarterly full releases + monthly security deltas.
jess_sre: Ops caveats: for large models split into parts (<=40GB per part), include per-part SHA256; provide resumable apply tool. Every apply must create a pre-apply snapshot and produce a rollback token. If quantization/format changes we may need KV cache invalidation or migration — document this in the runbook.
erin_sales: Billing: Acme prefers billing on "applied". Is that realistic for offline sites?
vikram_se: We can bill on applied if the customer runs the apply tool which emits a signed apply.receipt (offline-signed token) and uploads it within 14 days. Otherwise bill on delivery. We'll include the receipt workflow in SOW.
mark_legal: Contract bullets: Emergency Signed Artifact within 24 hours available under Enterprise Support subject to expedited fee and customer confirmation of pickup logistics. Redwood not liable for physical transit. If customer chooses Customer-Sign Kit, include the Signing Kit Addendum and liability waiver. Also include export-control notice for cryptography and certain model components.
jess_sre: Runbook sample commands for ops checklist (short):
```
# verify checksums & detached signature
sha256sum -c redwood.manifest && openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.part1
# dry-run apply and emit signed receipt
./redwood-apply --bundle parts/ --verify --dry-run --emit-receipt > apply.receipt
# actual apply
./redwood-apply --bundle parts/ --verify --apply --snapshot /var/redwood/snap-$(date +%s)
```
erin_sales: They want explicit wording for "offline bundle verification" and "rollback path" we can paste into the SOW. Any suggestions?
vikram_se: Proposed SOW phrasing: "Redwood will deliver signed bundle artifacts (detached HSM-backed signatures or Customer-Sign Kit as chosen), accompanying SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX), and a documented offline apply & rollback runbook. Customer will verify checksums and signatures prior to apply. Redwood provides tooling to create a pre-apply snapshot and a rollback token to revert to the previous state if needed."
mark_legal: Add acceptance and remediation clause: "Post-apply acceptance window: 5 business days. If Customer reports a functional regression within the acceptance window, Redwood will provide one remediation delta free of charge and assist with rollback."
erin_sales: What about the 24h hotfix ask and courier pickup?\ess_jess_sre: (typo) jess_sre: 24h signed artifact is doable under Enterprise + expedited fee. Courier pickup scheduling is customer responsibility; we'll provide tamper-evident packaging checklist and chain-of-custody forms to attach.\ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket SALES-99990 (deliverables: 1-page ops checklist, final SOW snippet for HSM vs Customer-Sign, expedited-fee schedule, offline receipt workflow).\er in_sales: (typo) erin_sales: OK team 44d Please drop the one-pager + final SOW lines and the expedited fee table here by COB so I can send to Acme.
vikram_se: I'll post the 1-page ops checklist (with timings: verify ~5-15m/part, apply 30-120m depending on model) and sample manifest schema in ~90m.
mark_legal: I'll post the contract snippets and Signing Kit Addendum template by EOD.
jess_sre: I'll add KV cache migration notes and an example rollback command in ~2h.
erin_sales: Thanks all 44d once drafts are in I'll consolidate and circulate to Acme.
